title: The Understudy WIP
description: Work-in-progress build of The Understudy, a new playable character for Slay the Spire 2. Shared for friend testing. Requires BaseLib.
changeNote: v1.13.33: Fixed Planned play order in the draw/discard selection: it now follows your click order (the numbered badges) instead of an arbitrary internal order, so reordering mid-selection no longer makes the visual order disagree with the actual order. Especially relevant in multiplayer.
